items.title: OpenMage magento-lts Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in its error pages, which print SCRIPT_NAME-derived URLs without escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can craft links to execute script in victims' browsers.

items.title: OpenMage magento-lts Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Product Name
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability where product names in storefront MSRP/MAP popup and Qty Increments notice templates are output without proper escaping. Attackers with admin product-edit rights can store a malicious product name that executes script when shoppers view product, category, or wishlist pages.

items.title: OpenMage Magento LTS Cross-Site Request Forgery in OAuth
items.summary: OpenMage Magento LTS before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the admin and storefront OAuth confirm and confirmSimple actions. Attackers holding OAuth consumer credentials can lure a logged-in administrator or customer to a crafted confirm URL to authorize the attacker's request token, leading to a persistent REST API access token.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium that could result in arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. It includes CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap), a CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE.

items.title: BlockStrap: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: BlockStrap (CVE-2026-103849) is a CVSS 10.0 Magento and Adobe Commerce flaw that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution via template engine injection. Adobe fixed it in APSB26-153, but new installs may remain vulnerable without a manual patch.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted File Upload leading to Remote Code Execution
items.summary: CVE-2026-48356, dubbed PolyShell, is a critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.6/9.3) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload a dangerous file type, leading to arbitrary code execution. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active exploitation, with Sansec reporting hundreds of infected stores.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler Hotfix)
items.summary: This emergency security update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this CVE being actively exploited in the wild as a zero-day.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (Zero-Day)
items.summary: StyleSmuggler (CVE-2026-75650) is a maximum-severity (CVSS 10.0) unauthenticated Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. It was actively exploited as a zero-day, allowing attackers to inject malicious PHP code through the template engine's `styles` property.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, including two critical stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and several incorrect authorization issues. Six of these vulnerabilities are exploitable without authentication.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves seven vulnerabilities, including critical, important, and moderate issues that could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. It notably includes CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated customer account takeover.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: CVE-2026-71362 is a critical (CVSS 9.1) incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. This flaw was actively exploited shortly after public disclosure.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-48356) that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe was not aware of in-the-wild exploitation at the time of publication, but it has since been actively exploited.
